# anthropic_effective_spend_limits (Data Source)

Lists the spend limit each member of a Claude Enterprise organization resolves, with the spend so far in the current period and the scope the limit is inherited from. The API returns one entry per member and period. The Spend Limits API is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only, and the API key needs the `read:spend_limits` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_effective_spend_limits" "monthly" {
  periods = ["monthly"]
}

output "members_on_an_inherited_limit" {
  value = [
    for limit in data.anthropic_effective_spend_limits.monthly.effective_spend_limits :
    limit.actor.email_address if limit.source.type != "user"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `periods` (Set of String) Return only the entries for these periods, at most 3. The API documents `daily`, `weekly` and `monthly`. Leave it unset to return one entry for each period a member resolves a limit for.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Return only these members, by tagged user ID (`user_...`), at most 100.

### Read-Only

- `effective_spend_limits` (Attributes List) The effective limit of each matching member and period, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_spend_limits))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.

<a id="nestedatt--effective_spend_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_spend_limits`

Read-Only:

- `actor` (Attributes) The member the entry reports on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--actor))
- `amount` (String) The effective cap on spend within the period, as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of `currency` (cents for USD). Null when no limit applies for the period. Another period can still cap the member.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency, the unit of `amount` and `period_to_date_spend`.
- `period` (String) The period the entry reports the limit and the spend for.
- `period_to_date_spend` (String) The member's spend so far in the current period, as a non-negative decimal string in the minor unit of `currency`, with up to three decimal places. Reads `0` when the spend reading is temporarily unavailable.
- `scope` (Attributes) The scope the entry reports on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--scope))
- `source` (Attributes) The scope the effective limit is inherited from. A `user` source is the member's own override, which `anthropic_spend_limit` manages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--source))
- `spend_limit_id` (String) ID of the spend limit the effective limit comes from (`spl_...`). Null when the API returns none.

<a id="nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--actor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_spend_limits.actor`

Read-Only:

- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the user's account has been deleted, for a `user_actor`. Null otherwise.
- `email_address` (String) The user's email address. Null when the account is unavailable or deleted.
- `name` (String) The user's display name. Null when the account is unavailable or deleted, or has no name.
- `scoped_api_key_id` (String) ID of the scoped API key, for a `scoped_api_key_actor`. Null otherwise.
- `type` (String) `user_actor` or `scoped_api_key_actor`.
- `user_id` (String) Tagged ID of the user, for a `user_actor`. Null otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_spend_limits.scope`

Read-Only:

- `rbac_group_id` (String) ID of the group, for an `rbac_group` type. Null otherwise.
- `seat_tier` (String) The seat tier, for a `seat_tier` type. Null otherwise.
- `service` (String) The service, for an `organization_service` type. Null otherwise.
- `type` (String) Type of the scope. The API documents `user`, `seat_tier`, `rbac_group`, `organization_service`, `organization`, `workspace` and `usage_tier`, and can add types.
- `user_id` (String) Tagged ID of the member, for a `user` type. Null otherwise.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace, for a `workspace` type. Null otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--effective_spend_limits--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_spend_limits.source`

Read-Only:

- `rbac_group_id` (String) ID of the group, for an `rbac_group` type. Null otherwise.
- `seat_tier` (String) The seat tier, for a `seat_tier` type. Null otherwise.
- `service` (String) The service, for an `organization_service` type. Null otherwise.
- `type` (String) Type of the source scope. The API documents `user`, `seat_tier`, `rbac_group`, `organization_service`, `organization`, `workspace` and `usage_tier`, and can add types.
- `user_id` (String) Tagged ID of the member, for a `user` type. Null otherwise.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace, for a `workspace` type. Null otherwise.
